items.title: Summa (version for eight cellos)
items.notes: Pärt's 2010 version for cello octet (also for four cellos); slow tintinnabuli chords

items.title: Psalom (version for eight cellos)
items.notes: Pärt's 2010 version for eight cellos; the string-quartet version is the better known

items.title: Pari intervallo (version for eight cellos)

items.title: Silouan's Song (version for eight cellos)
items.notes: Rewritten by Pärt for eight cellos at the suggestion of the Cello Octet Amsterdam; original for strings (1991)

items.title: Missa brevis (version for eight cellos)
items.notes: Kyrie, Sanctus, Agnus Dei; Pärt's eight-cello version of the 12-cello original, made for the Cello Octet Amsterdam

items.title: Da pacem Domine (version for eight cellos)

items.title: O-Antiphonen (version for eight cellos)

items.title: Solfeggio (version for eight cellos)
